title: Nonparametric Identification of Two-Way Unobserved Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2608.27155v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study identification of two-way unobserved heterogeneity in the nonparametric panel regression $G_{it}=g(\alpha_i,\gamma_t)+\varepsilon_{it}$, where identification of the latent types reduces to constructing identified, \emph{injective} proxies for them. To this end we consider the singular value decomposition (SVD) of the bivariate regression function $g(\alpha,\gamma)$ on a product domain $\Omega_\alpha\times\Omega_\gamma$, whose left singular functions $\{u_r\}$ serve as proxies for the unobserved heterogeneity parameter $\alpha$. The arguments are symmetric for $\{v_r\}$ vis-\`a-vis $\gamma$. We work under an \emph{observational-equivalence simplification}: two values of $\alpha$ that induce the same conditional response $g(\alpha,\cdot)$ are identified, so that the response map $\alpha\mapsto g(\alpha,\cdot)$ is injective by construction. translated_title: 非参数识别双向未观测异质性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27155v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们研究非参数面板回归$G_{it}=g(\alpha_i,\gamma_t)+\varepsilon_{it}$中双向未观测异质性的识别问题，其中潜在类型的识别归结为构建已识别的、单射的代理变量。为此，我们考虑乘积域$\Omega_\alpha\times\Omega_\gamma$上二元回归函数$g(\alpha,\gamma)$的奇异值分解（SVD），其左奇异函数$\{u_r\}$作为未观测异质性参数$\alpha$的代理。对于$\{v_r\}$与$\gamma$的论证是对称的。我们在“观测等价简化”假设下工作：诱导相同条件响应$g(\alpha,\cdot)$的两个$\alpha$值被视为已识别，因此响应映射$\alpha\mapsto g(\alpha,\cdot)$通过构造是单射的。我们证明了两点：首先，这种简化等价于完全协方差的单射性。
tldr: 本文提出利用奇异值分解构建单射代理变量，在观测等价简化下证明非参数面板回归中双向未观测异质性的识别等价于协方差映射的单射性。
en_tdlr: This paper uses singular value decomposition to construct injective proxies, showing that under observational-equivalence simplification, identification of two-way unobserved heterogeneity in nonparametric panel regression is equivalent to injectivity of the full covariance map.
